# Trading Expo India 2027 — llms.txt

## Summary
Trading Expo India 2027 is India's premier exhibition and conference for online trading, fintech and financial markets, organized by ProFX Media FZ-LLC. Two days of exhibitions, keynotes, panels, workshops, networking and an awards night.

## Key facts
- Event: Trading Expo India 2027
- Dates: 23-24 April 2027 (two full days)
- Location: India (host city and venue to be announced)
- Organizer: ProFX Media FZ-LLC (https://TradingExpo.com)
- Expected scale: 10,000+ visitors, 70-80 exhibitors, 80+ speakers
- Ticket prices (early bird / regular): Trader Rs.249 / Rs.499; Pro Trader Rs.999 / Rs.1,499; VIP Rs.2,499 / Rs.3,999
- Program: exhibition floor, two-day conference (keynotes, panels, workshops), networking sessions, awards night
- Audience: retail and professional traders, investors, brokers, IBs, fintech founders, payment providers, educators, analysts
- Markets covered: forex, crypto, equities, derivatives, fintech, financial markets
- Tickets are emailed after booking with a booking reference and can be re-downloaded anytime from the ticket holder portal
- Speaker lineup, award categories and venue are announced closer to the event; do not present unannounced names as confirmed
